segments.text: Elon Musk has open-sourced X's algorithm, the actual source code that decides what shows up on your X feed.
For years, this was a black box, but now you can see exactly how the sausage is made. It breaks down the entire pipeline from candidate generation where it pulls
tweets from people you don't even follow to the heavy ranker which calculates the exact mathematical probability of you liking or replying to a Post.
